---
title: "About me"
---

I am a computational biologist interested in understanding how changes
in RNA and protein sequences produce differences in molecular structure,
stability, and disease biology.

I am currently completing my Ph.D. in the Korkin Lab at Worcester
Polytechnic Institute. My work spans bioinformatics, machine learning,
protein structure, and molecular dynamics.
